body.message: We only do short-term holiday home rentals, so no annual lease or Ejari, but a lot of people in your situation start with a 3-month block at a fixed rate and just keep renewing. It ends up being very stable long-term. The 2BR is free from September 3, which lines up with when you're looking to move in. Does the 3-month setup sound like something that could work for you?
